items.title: Last day to object to the termination (Widerspruch under §§ 574-574b BGB)
items.quote: Der Widerspruch bedarf der Textform und muss mir spätestens zwei Monate vor dem Ende des Mietverhältnisses zugehen.
items.computation: The letter was hand-delivered into the tenant's mailbox by a courier of the law firm on 19.11.2026 at 9:15 - a private (non-postal, non-authority) delivery, so the stated calendar date of delivery counts directly, no 3/4-day fiction applies. The tenancy is terminated ordinarily to 31.05.2027 (the stated end date). Under § 574b BGB the tenant's objection must reach the landlord's representative at the latest two months before that end date. Counting two months back from 31.05.2027 by the same-day-number rule (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB analogy: X months before a date falls on the day with the same number) gives 31.03.2027. This is a substantive notice-type deadline (like a cancellation notice period) and does not shift for weekends or holidays; in any case 31.03.2027 is a Wednesday, so no adjustment would be needed anyway.

items.title: End of tenancy / move-out date
items.quote: kündigen wir das Mietverhältnis über die Wohnung Innstraße 21, Erdgeschoss, ordentlich zum 31.05.2027.
items.computation: The landlords, through their attorney, give ordinary notice of termination effective on the calendar date stated in the letter, 31.05.2027. A calendar date printed in the letter is used as written and is not subject to weekend/holiday adjustment. This is the last day of the tenancy, by which the tenant must have vacated (unless a valid objection under § 574 BGB leads to continuation).
